formats.name: Biscuit
formats.notes: A bearer token by design: anyone holding it can use it and attenuate it. Paths are checked with starts_with, one of several ways to write this in Datalog. Revocation is a documented non-goal of the library, which exposes block IDs for you to check.

formats.name: UCAN Ed25519
formats.notes: Paths use the UCAN policy language's glob match, which treats a path as plain text. Replay, revocation and depth limits are optional checks you switch on. The depth limit is the verifier's, one for every chain, rather than set per delegation in the token. pq-ucan is maintained by the authors of this benchmark.
